**The meaning of the verses**
﴿وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا ۚ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ ۖ وَلَا تَنقُصُوا الْمِكْيَالَ وَالْمِيزَانَ ۚ إِنِّي أَرَاكُم بِخَيْرٍ وَإِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ مُّحِيطٍ﴾

And to Madyan We sent their brother Shu'ayb. He said: "O my people, worship Allah alone; you have no god worthy of worship other than Him, exalted and majestic is He, so worship Him sincerely. And do not cut short people's rights in their measures and scales. I see you living in plenty, and I fear for you — because of cutting short the measure and the scale — the punishment of a Day that will surround you."

﴿وَيَا قَوْمِ أَوْفُوا الْمِكْيَالَ وَالْمِيزَانَ بِالْقِسْطِ ۖ وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا النَّاسَ أَشْيَاءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ﴾

"And O my people, give full measure and full weight with justice, and do not cut short people's rights in any of their things, and do not go about the land doing acts of disobedience to Allah and spreading corruption."

📖 At-Tafsir Al-Muyassar — King Fahd Complex.

**Talk with your child**
1. How did Hajj Mubarak weigh the dates? And how did Faris weigh them? And why did people go to Faris at first?
2. What did Hajj Mubarak mean when he said, "The other pan isn't mine"? And why did people come back to him afterwards?
3. No one saw Faris's finger on the pan, but was that hidden from Allah? And is the extra date required of every seller? (What is required is full weight with nothing missing; a little extra is praiseworthy kindness, not an obligation.)

**This week's exercise**
Whenever your child shares something between themselves and someone else this week (sweets, fruit, time with a toy), they divide it themselves and then let the other person choose first; so they learn to make the division fair, because the other pan belongs to someone else.
